answers.core: the original proposal, which broke pre 4.4 functionality, was core: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/6406, so it would be nice for this to be core as well.  but see also the previous section.
answers.workaround:
this can be partially worked around with an editor plugin, e.g., you could switch between approaches https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/6406#issuecomment-2699552948 -- but in fact it's nice to have both for muscle memory purposes, and not just to switch from one to the other.

the other reason it shouldn't be an addon/plugin -- it also makes the current functionality easier to understand (e.g., with emulate 3-button mouse), and also clarifies the need to set a shortcut for these primary methods.
